# ResultSniper BD (ResultSniper BD — Shahriyar Sojib Hasan)
> Fast, resilient Bangladesh Education Board Result Extraction, Merit Analytics & 1-Page A4/Letter Cryptographically Verified Marksheet Platform (English default + Bangla toggle).

## Architecture & Live API Engines
1. **eduboardresults.gov.bd (Official Full Marks Engine)**: Fetches candidate profiles and subject-wise numerical marks (`getStudentResult`) with human-solved 6-char captcha, EIIN, Session, and Student Type.
2. **result.bangladeshgov.org (All-Board Gateway)**: Supports SSC, HSC, JSC, DIBS across all 11 Education Boards (2015–2026) with `sub_details` resolution and 4-digit security key, automatically suppressing missing `[NOT SHOWN]` fields when candidate Registration No. is provided.
3. **1-Year Private Server Cache (`POST /api/cache/check`)**: Credential-keyed (SHA-256 Roll + Registration) SQLite + Vercel Private Blob store returning previously fetched results in milliseconds for up to 365 days, reducing upstream server congestion.
4. **api.ebr.bd Transparency**: `api.ebr.bd` enforces Cloudflare Turnstile bound to `ebr.bd`; ResultSniper BD never circumvents Turnstile and instead offers a clean 1-click Roll/Reg copy + new-tab helper.

## Security & Distinct 1-Page Print PDFs
- **Distinct Result PDF vs Verification PDF**: Result Marksheet uses an Emerald/Gold academic summary structure (with Roll, Reg, Name, Parents, Board, Group, Session, Type, EIIN, Institution, and adaptive marks/grade-only columns), while `/verify` outputs a Navy/Teal Cryptographic Authenticity Certificate PDF (`HMAC-SHA256` audit strip).
- **Light Currency Wave Underprint & Unbroken Borders**: Soft pastel guilloche curves, rosettes, microtext frame, and official board crests inside crisp unbroken border frames fitting 1 single A4 or US Letter page.
- **HMAC-SHA256 Verification**: Stateless compressed payload + signature embedded in QR code (`/verify?t=<TOKEN>`).

## Endpoints
- `GET /`: Bilingual (EN default / BN toggle) multi-engine UI.
- `GET /verify?t={token}`: Public verification portal + 1-page A4/Letter printable certificate.
- `GET /api/verify?t={token}`: JSON verification endpoint.
- `GET /health`: Health check endpoint for 24/7 cloud uptime monitors.
- `GET /about`, `/terms`, `/privacy`, `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/llms.txt`
